The 2026-07-01 pricing snapshot listed a scheduled increase to $3/$3.75/$6/$0.30/$15 on 2026-09-01, but on 2026-08-10 Anthropic made $2/$10 the standard price and the increase never took effect (release notes + current pricing page footnote 3).
